austinToday.text: Thanksgiving is tomorrow. Two cold fronts have swept through, so it will be a sweater-weather holiday.
austinToday.label: FOX 7

austinToday.text: The Zilker Holiday Tree turns 60 this year. It lights up Sunday evening, and you can see it every night through New Year's Day.
austinToday.label: City of Austin

austinToday.text: The Longhorns beat Arkansas 45 to 3 on Saturday. They play Texas A&M on Friday night.
austinToday.label: Texas Athletics

austinToday.text: The Bullock Museum has a new exhibit about the 1990s. It's sure to bring back memories of the grandchildren's childhoods.
austinToday.label: Bullock Museum

items.title: Zilker Holiday Tree Lighting
items.when: Sunday, Nov 29 · lighting at 6 pm (music from 5:15)
items.blurb: The 60th lighting of Austin's tree of lights, with the Austin Civic Wind Ensemble playing beforehand.

items.title: See the Zilker Tree on a quiet night
items.when: Every evening, 6 to 10 pm, through Jan 1
items.blurb: Weeknights are calm, and parking on the paved lots is free. It's lovely even from the car window.

items.title: The Holiday Market at ZACH
items.place: The People's Plaza at ZACH, 202 S Lamar
items.blurb: An open-air market of local makers on Small Business Saturday. Also Dec 12 and Dec 19.

items.title: The Holiday Market at ZACH
items.place: The People's Plaza at ZACH, 202 S Lamar
items.blurb: Local makers, holiday drinks and gifts, right outside the theater.

items.title: A Christmas Carol
items.blurb: ZACH's beloved holiday tradition. Afternoon shows are an easy outing.

items.title: The Nutcracker
items.when: Dec 4 to 23 · 2 pm matinees most weekends
items.place: Ballet Austin at the Long Center, Dell Hall
items.blurb: Ballet Austin's 63rd Nutcracker. About two hours, with a 20-minute intermission.

items.title: The Met Opera in HD: Samson et Dalila
items.blurb: Saint-Saëns's lush opera, broadcast live from New York to a cinema near you.

items.title: Houdini's Library
items.when: On view through Feb 7 · Tue–Fri 10–5, Sat–Sun noon–5
items.blurb: The great magician's own books and secrets, from his famous library.

items.title: The Worlds of Gertrude Stein
items.blurb: Paris salons, Picasso, and the writer who knew everyone.

items.title: The 90s: Last Decade Before the Future
items.place: Bullock Texas State History Museum, 1800 N Congress
items.blurb: A playful look back at the 1990s. Fun to visit with a grandchild.

sections.title: University of Texas
sections.subtitle: Open to the public on the Forty Acres

items.title: Hullabaloo Hooray: The History of Texas Spirit
items.place: Stark Center, north end zone of the stadium
items.blurb: A small exhibit on Longhorn traditions, just in time for the A&M game.

items.title: Revolutions and Constitutions
items.place: Benson Latin American Collection, Sid Richardson Hall
items.blurb: Nation-building in the Americas after 1776, from the Benson's rare collections.

items.title: Faculty Book Talk: Inside the Body of Black Feminism
items.blurb: A conversation with historian Marcia Chatelain about a new book on science, race and culture.

items.title: Browse every UT event
items.when: Lectures from every college and graduate school
items.blurb: The university's full calendar of public talks, concerts and exhibits.

sections.title: From Your Armchair
sections.subtitle: Live online talks and tours to watch at home

items.title: Corporate Clean Energy Deals
items.blurb: A lunchtime UT talk on record-breaking clean-energy deals.

items.title: Picasso, Miró, Dalí: Artists' Books
items.place: Online, from the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
items.blurb: Curator Edward Saywell on the illustrated books these artists made. The Zoom link comes by email.

items.title: The Spirits of the 12 Days of Christmas
items.blurb: A lecture on old British Christmas customs, hosted by Art Fund.

items.title: Texas Exes Lunchtime Lectures
items.when: Free online talks by UT professors
items.blurb: Short lectures that bring back a taste of college days.

sections.title: The Book Nook
sections.subtitle: Good reads, free with your library card

items.title: Kin, by Tayari Jones
items.when: One of the Times's best books of the year so far
items.blurb: A lush historical novel about two sisters. Borrow it free on Libby, and turn up the text size as big as you like.

items.title: The Boundless Deep, by Richard Holmes
items.when: One of the Times's best books of the year so far
items.blurb: From the wonderful biographer of the Romantic poets and scientists.

items.title: Read Gertrude Stein, then see her
items.when: Pairs with the Ransom Center show
items.place: The Autobiography of Alice B. Toklas
items.blurb: Stein's witty, gossipy memoir of Paris. Read it, then visit the exhibit before Jan 24.

longhorns.headline: Texas routed Arkansas on Saturday
longhorns.next: Friday, Nov 27 at 6:30 pm, at Texas A&M (on ABC)
lines: Texas is ranked No. 8 in the country.
Friday is the Lone Star Showdown against the Aggies in College Station.
Arch Manning is the quarterback, and yes, he's Peyton and Eli's nephew.
Back in September, Texas came back from 23 to 3 down to beat No. 1 Ohio State, 24 to 23.
